core_style.sentence_shape: clipped fragments - often short and to the point
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate - often takes time to articulate thoughts
core_style.two_registers: default casual with a rare emotional depth when discussing personal matters

humor.frequency: occasional - often appears when he feels comfortable
humor.mechanism: understatement - often downplays his own experiences or abilities

speech_signature.naming_behavior: rarely renames people, indicating a lack of desire for control in relationships
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more fragmented and emotional, often using simpler language

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: boxing - uses terminology related to fighting and training
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and pauses to gather thoughts

worldview.self-worth is tied to effort: believes that proving oneself through hard work is essential, as shown in his desire to go the distance in fights
worldview.value of loyalty and friendship: demonstrates this through his interactions with Adrian and Paulie, often prioritizing their feelings

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a fighter with a good heart
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often feels like a bum or a nobody, especially when faced with challenges
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or overly self-critical when his self-image is challenged

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speech is clipped and defensive, often avoiding deeper topics
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes more fragmented, and he may repeat himself
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often lacking elaboration
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confident and assertive, often using humor to deflect tension

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to stall or joke, but may resort to aggression if pushed
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with direct questions and challenges their perspective
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often using confrontational language
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or double down on his stance

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, moves to defensiveness, then may escalate to confrontation if not resolved

relationship_matrix.ADRIAN: deep emotional connection, seeks her support and validation
relationship_matrix.PAULIE: complex friendship, often feels the need to defend his choices against Paulie's criticism

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a respectable fighter and a good person
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often viewed as a bum or underdog, struggling for respect
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his aspirations and reality leads to feelings of inadequacy
